_about: Every model input is entered once here, with its source. 'assumption' marks values without a published source; these are listed in MODEL_SPEC.md Section 9 and in the paper. Times are in minutes.

base_visits_per_day.source: assumption: large urban ED (about 80,000 visits per year); chosen so that physician teams per shift are large enough for stable dedicated sub-pools at high load (DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-08)

hourly_profile.source: assumption: typical diurnal ED arrival shape (night trough, late-morning peak); normalised to mean 1 in code

acuity_mix._source: Holroyd2016_EDCaseMix: pooled CTAS distribution and between-site ranges for the 16 highest-volume Alberta EDs (NACRS, 2013/14). 'community' is the pooled distribution; the other two archetypes lie inside the reported ranges, near their ends.

tertiary.source: Holroyd2016_EDCaseMix ranges (CTAS1 0.2-2.8%, CTAS2 3.3-33.3%, CTAS3 29.1-54.1%, CTAS4 16.7-49.0%, CTAS5 3.1-12.3%); high-acuity end

admission_probability_by_ctas.source: Holroyd2016_EDCaseMix: midpoints of the reported between-site ranges (CTAS1 43.9-75.2%, CTAS2 18.9-42.1%, CTAS3 5.4-24.7%, CTAS4 0.8-9.3%, CTAS5 0.1-9.1%)

pathways.source: Rismanchian2023_PatientJourney: the 11 most frequent pathways (78.6% of visits); renormalised within each disposition

diagnostic_tilt_by_ctas.source: assumption: log-weight change per diagnostic/consult step, by CTAS level (higher acuity -> more diagnostics); 0 for CTAS 3 reproduces the published frequencies

diagnostic_intensity_shift.source: assumption: added to every CTAS tilt (factor 'diagnostic intensity')

durations._note: Lognormal, given by mean and coefficient of variation (CV). Sampled once per patient, so they do not depend on the policy.

low.source: assumption informed by provincial median waits for an inpatient bed (Alberta 3.6 h, Ontario 7 h, 2022/23; Li2023_EDOvercrowdingCADTH)

high.source: assumption informed by the same figures (upper level)

capacity_sizing._note: Capacities are derived by code from these targets for the 'medium' load level; the same capacities are then used at all load levels (load changes the arrival rate).

space_sizing_utilisation.source: calibration: treatment spaces sized on service-only holding time (waits excluded); 0.60 keeps the high load level stable, with 90th-percentile door-to-physician times of the same order as the Canadian national value (DECISIONS.md, 2026-11-08)

diagnostic_target_utilisation.source: design choice: diagnostics are not the main bottleneck

load_levels.source: design: offered load of the busiest physician pool (whole ED for POOLED and SPLITFLOW; the busier of Main and fast track under CTAS 4-5 streaming for FASTTRACK); reached by scaling the arrival rate

ctas_targets_minutes.source: Bullard2017_CTAS response-time objectives for physician assessment; CTAS1 'immediate' adapted to 15 min (study-specific)

prediction._note: Predicted attributes come from the true ones through confusion matrices. M(alpha) = I + alpha (M_ref - I); alpha = 0 is perfect information, alpha = 1 the reference accuracy.

service_class_quantiles.source: design: five equal-frequency classes of total treatment time, cut points from the community/typical ED

admission.source: assumption, in the range reported for triage-time admission models (e.g. Hong2018_disposition, SUN2011_disposition)

service.source: assumption: exact-class accuracy for a five-class ordinal target; errors go mostly to neighbouring classes

ordinal_error_decay.source: assumption: error mass on a class at distance d is proportional to decay^(d-1)

warmup_days.source: MSER-5 on pilot runs at high load: largest truncation point 15 h (experiments/results/E0_pilot/warmup_mser5); 2 days leaves a margin

max_cooldown_days.source: design: arrivals continue after the observation window until every observed patient has left

replications.source: CI half-width rule on 10 pilot replications: fewer than 25 needed for a 5% relative half-width of mean LOS in every core ED type (experiments/results/E0_pilot/replications_needed)

replications_secondary.source: design: prediction-error sweep (E4), sensitivity runs (E5) and fidelity runs (E3); comparisons there are paired under common random numbers
